problems.original_quote: Crucially, however, the question of whether the identity of reviewers affects this relationship remains
problems.revised_quote: However, to the best of our knowledge, whether the identity of reviewers affects this relationship remains
problems.explanation: The emphasis adverb "Crucially," which signals the importance of the research gap, was dropped.

parsed.summary: The revision keeps all claims, numbers, citations, hedges ("to the best of our knowledge", "somewhat underexplored", "novel"), and the recommendation at the same strength. Dropping "in the existing literature" does not change the scope, and the only loss is the emphasis word "Crucially".
